programmeCorrections: Default foundation schedule is Monday, Wednesday, Friday, with at least a rest day between full-body sessions. Two sessions are also acceptable when recovery requires it.
No automatic mandatory switch to a split after one or two weeks. Existing splits are optional adaptations of the provided notes.
Sets reduced to conservative starting amounts; beginners do not require drop sets or failure.
Corrected blanket claims about knees never passing toes, machines always being safer, isolation of lower abs and face pulls fixing posture.
